name: keypin
description: Parcel identification number (PIN). Primary PIN used for valuing properties associated with multiple PINs.

name: pins
description: All PINs associated with primary PIN that should be valued collectively

name: modelgroup
description: Sheet from associated excel workbook that contains row on assessor's website

name: class(es)
description: Class of key PIN or classes of key PIN and some or all associated PINs

name: tot_units
description: Total number of units (can include hotel rooms, nursing home rooms, residential apartments, commercial units etc.)

name: aprx_comm_sf
description: Approximate commercial square footage for key PIN and all associated PINs

name: bldgsf
description: Building square footage for key PIN and all associated PINs

name: carwash
description: Car wash at location (gas station/convenience store specific) - A = "Yes", B = "No"

name: cost/day/bed
description: Cost per day per bed (nursing home specific)

name: costapproach/sf
description: Cost approach value per square foot

name: ebitda%
description: Earnings before interest taxes depreciation and amortization %

name: excesslandarea
description: Excess land area (land area above 4:1 land to building)

name: f/r
description: Fast food operation / rental space (gas station/convenience store specific)

name: finalmarketvalue/bed
description: Final market value per bed (nursing home specific)

name: finalmarketvalue/key
description: Final market value per key (529 class specific)

name: finalmarketvalue/sf
description: Final market value per square foot

name: finalmarketvalue/unit
description: Final market value per unit (multifamily specific)

name: idphlicense#
description: Illinois department of health license number

name: incomemarketvalue/sf
description: Value per square foot derived from income approach

name: land:bldg
description: Land square footage to building square footage ratio for key PIN and all associated PINs

name: landsf
description: Land square footage for key PIN and all associated PINs

name: permit/partial/demovalue
description: Partial value due to uncompleted new construction or demolition

name: permit/partial/demovalue_reason
description: Reason for partial value due to uncompleted new construction or demolition

name: revenuebed/day
description: Revenue per bed per day (nursing home specific)

name: roomrev%
description: Percentage of revenue from room rentals (hotel specific)

name: salecompmarketvalue/sf
description: Value per square foot derived from comparables approach

name: sap
description: In affordable housing special assessment program

name: sapdeduction
description: Reduction from affordable housing special assessment program

name: saptier
description: Tier of affordable housing special assessment program
